import sys, os, tempfile, unittest
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "stage/hooks/tests"); sys.path.insert(0, "stage/hooks")
import test_stage_guard as T
from test_stage_guard import stage_guard, decision, message, reason
class P(T.StageGuardTest):
    def test_probe(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp); self.write_purpose_reminder_fixture(root)
            def run(p):
                p = {"cwd": str(root), "session_id": "s", **p}
                r = stage_guard.handle_event("pre-tool-use", p)
                return decision(r), message(r)
            os.environ["MYTMP"] = tempfile.gettempdir()
            cases = {
              "edit+transcript": {"transcript_path": "/root/.claude/x.jsonl","tool_name":"Edit","tool_input":{"file_path":"stage/hooks/y.py","old_string":"a","new_string":"b"}},
              "devnull2": {"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"ls 2> /dev/null"}},
              "tmpfoo": {"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"echo hi > /tmp/foo.txt"}},
              "TMPDIR braced": {"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":'cp a "${MYTMP}/x"'}},
              "Write /tmp": {"tool_name":"Write","tool_input":{"file_path":"/tmp/zz/a.txt","content":"x"}},
              "outside proj file": {"tool_name":"Edit","tool_input":{"file_path":"README.md","old_string":"a","new_string":"b"}},
              "bash outside proj": {"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"echo x > docs/a.md"}},
              "etc": {"tool_name":"Write","tool_input":{"file_path":"/etc/stagefoo","content":"x"}},
              "home": {"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"echo x > /home/u/f.txt"}},
              "dotdot escape into tmp?": {"tool_name":"Write","tool_input":{"file_path":"/dev/../etc/x","content":"x"}},
            }
            for k,v in cases.items(): print(k, "=>", run(v))
            # stage gate
            self.write_work_item(root, status="completed", verification="passed", retrospective="completed", promotion="approved")
            r = stage_guard.handle_event("pre-tool-use", {"cwd":str(root),"tool_name":"Bash","transcript_path":"/tmp/t.jsonl","tool_input":{"command":"echo x > .stage/past/canon/principles.md"}})
            print("gate bash", decision(r), reason(r)[:80])
unittest.main(argv=["x","P.test_probe"], verbosity=0)
EOF
